label: 🔌 JDBC
description: Read from / write to any database that ships a JDBC driver — Postgres, MySQL, Oracle, MS SQL Server, DB2, Snowflake, Teradata, Vertica, etc. Requires a Java runtime on the host and a path to the driver JAR. The URI is a literal jdbc: connection string (e.g. jdbc:postgresql://host:5432/db).

driverClass.label: JDBC driver class
driverClass.help: Fully-qualified Java class name. Examples: org.postgresql.Driver · com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver · oracle.jdbc.OracleDriver · com.microsoft.sqlserver.jdbc.SQLServerDriver

jarPath.label: Driver JAR path
jarPath.help: Absolute path to the .jar file (or a directory of jars). Download from the database vendor.

username.label: Username
username.help: Optional — many drivers also accept user= in the URI.

password.label: Password
password.help: Stored in the pipeline document. Prefer environment-variable interpolation — e.g. ${MY_DB_PASS} — when shipping pipelines around.

table.label: Table name
table.help: Reads SELECT * FROM <table>. Schema-qualify if needed (e.g. analytics.orders). Leave blank to use a custom query.

query.label: Custom SQL query
query.help: Used when 'Table name' is blank. Executed verbatim against the database.
